notes.title: Welcome to the 'Serial Victims' Steam Page!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Welcome to the official Steam page for [b]Serial Victims[/b]!

I am thrilled to have you here and excited to share this journey with you. Serial Victims is my first commercial release, and I can't wait for you to experience it when it launches early next year. 🚀

As I continue to develop and refine the game, your support and feedback will be invaluable. Here are a few ways you can stay connected and contribute:

[list]
[*] [b]Wishlist the Game:[/b] Adding Serial Victims to your wishlist will not only help you stay updated with all the latest news and updates, but it also greatly supports me in getting the game in front of more players. 

[*] [b]Follow on Social Media:[/b] Stay in the loop by following [b]'Blue Column Games'[/b] on all social media channels. I’ll be posting regular updates, sneak peeks, and other content. Plus, it’s a great way to engage with what can hopefully become a great community.
 
[*] [b]Share Your Feedback and Ideas:[/b] I am committed to making Serial Victims the best it can be, and I believe that your input can make a big difference. Feel free to leave comments, start discussions, and share your ideas with me. Your feedback is essential, and I am always eager to hear from my community.
[/list]

Expect regular updates from me, detailing progress, showcasing new features, and perhaps a few surprises along the way. I'm passionate about this project and would genuinely appreciate your support and shared enthusiasm.

Thank you for joining me on this adventure!

Best regards,

Thijs / Blue Column Games

P.S. Don't forget to hit that subscribe... I mean wishlist button! 👍
